page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn6i.24xlarge is an x86_64 bare-metal server instance tailored for accelerated computing. The platform is powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor providing 96 dedicated vCPUs paired with 384 GB of system memory, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is provided by four NVIDIA T4 GPUs, supplying a combined 64 GB of VRAM (16 GB per GPU) for concurrent acceleration workloads.

Network connectivity features a baseline throughput of 30 Gbps, supporting significant ingest and egress capabilities across distributed deployments. The instance does not include integrated local storage, requiring persistent data handling to be routed to external cloud disks or network-attached storage architectures. Zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the aggregation of four NVIDIA T4 accelerators in a single bare-metal host reduces hypervisor overhead and offers high resource density for parallel inference pipelines without the capital expense of high-tier training accelerators. The absence of local disk drives necessitates factoring in additional networked storage infrastructure. The configuration is primarily suitable for distributed machine learning inference, multi-stream video transcoding, graphics virtualization, and parallel batch data processing.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn6i.24xlarge is a dedicated bare-metal instance designed for hardware-accelerated computing workloads. Operating on an Intel Xeon 8163 x86_64 architecture, the server provides 96 dedicated vCPUs alongside 384 GB of system memory, matching a 4.0 GB per-vCPU ratio. Compute acceleration is handled by four integrated NVIDIA T4 GPUs offering 64 GB of cumulative VRAM, configured with 16 GB per card. System networking delivers a baseline bandwidth of 30 Gbps, while local disk storage is not bundled, relying on external network storage solutions. Combining high host compute density with multiple inference-oriented GPUs and bare-metal execution, this instance is suitable for scaled deep learning inference, batch video rendering, distributed machine learning pipelines, and graphics streaming environments.
